lines.zh: 我踩着山石一步步下来
lines.en: I come down the rocks, step by step.
My talons hook into the cracks.
I walk like some enormous cat.

lines.zh: 我半张着翅膀稳住身子
lines.en: I keep my wings half open for balance.

lines.zh: 我从一块岩石跳到下一块
lines.en: I hop from one rock to the next.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛被风吹得往后
lines.en: Wind pulls my mane back.

lines.zh: 我低头绕过突出的岩角
lines.en: I duck under an overhang.
I walk a stretch along the snowline.
My tail sways in the mountain wind.
I work my way down.

lines.zh: 我的影子从山壁上滑过
lines.en: My shadow slides along the cliff.
I stop on the ridge and look back.

lines.zh: 我蹲在岩台上，看着山下
lines.en: I crouch on the ledge and watch below.
The wind comes, and I do not stir.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀收得整整齐齐
lines.en: My wings are folded neatly.
I listen to the sound in the clouds.
The mountain is too high for you.

lines.zh: 我隔一会儿才眨一次眼
lines.en: I blink only once in a while.
My feathers ruffle in the wind.
This is my altitude.
I shift my talons.

lines.zh: 我低头理了理胸前的毛
lines.en: I preen the feathers on my chest.
I am waiting for an updraught.
The rock is warm, so I lie on it.
I yawn, showing my teeth.
The things below are so small.
You climbed all this way.
You are standing on my ridge.
I cock my head at you.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道是低处的
lines.en: You smell of lower ground.

lines.zh: 我不讨厌你，但你该退后
lines.en: I do not dislike you, but step back.
My wings open a little.

lines.zh: 你手里拿着缰绳做什么
lines.en: Why are you holding reins?
Have you seen a bee?
Your boots are slipping.
I stand, and I am much taller than you.
I lower my head and meet your eyes.
It cannot have been easy to get up here.

lines.zh: 我呼出的白气扑到你脸上
lines.en: My white breath puffs onto your face.

lines.zh: 你走一步，山石就落一块
lines.en: Every step you take, a stone falls.

lines.zh: 你仰头的样子让我不快
lines.en: The way you crane upward displeases me.
You woke me.
A few of my feathers came loose.
I toss my head and my mane bristles.
I did not expect that.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里低低滚了一声
lines.en: A low sound rolls in my throat.
My wing shudders.
I crush a stone in my grip.
My four legs are still under me.
I am marking this on my claw.
I fold my wings carefully.
You are more capable than I thought.
I smell pollen.
That is not what I want.
Did you bring a bee?
I fix on the buzzing thing.
Pollen on the wings matters.
I do not want meat, stop waving it.
The smell of pollen drowns out the meat.
That is nowhere near enough.

lines.zh: 你把那个活的东西放开
lines.en: Let that living thing go.
My snout follows it.

lines.zh: 我的爪子稳稳扣在岩面
lines.en: My claws stay locked to the rock.
I gave no ground at all.

lines.zh: 你被我的翅膀挡了一下
lines.en: My wing caught you.
Do not stand where I land.
I sweep over your head.
Rocks roll away under my step.
My tail brushes your shoulder.
The wind shifts as we pass.
I angle my body slightly.
Just step back and it is fine.
I am alone on this mountain.

lines.zh: 我没有性别，也没有伴侣
lines.en: I have no sex and no mate.
That does not concern me.

lines.zh: 我只要一片安静的山脊
lines.en: I only want a quiet ridge.
I have no use for it at all.
I turn my head off to one side.
The wind is better company.
I settle down and ignore you.
That is not for me to think about.

lines.zh: 我没有伴侣，也生不出蛋
lines.en: I have no mate and lay no eggs.
What falls on the mountain, I take.
I rake it over with a talon.
This thing has weight to it.
I take it and beat my wings.
It fell down the mountain.
My nose comes close, then turns away.
I pin it down with loose stones.
Whoever dropped it, I do not care.
I fly a stretch holding it.
I flick it off the rock ledge.
You stepped on my ledge.
My gaze has not left you.
The wings on my back have opened.
Get off this mountain.
I do not often lose my temper.
You are too close to my nest.
My talons are set.
My throat's low rumble rides the wind.

lines.zh: 我把前爪从岩台上抬起
lines.en: I lift my foreclaw off the rock ledge.
Even the wind here obeys me.
I have lowered my body.
You picked the worst spot.
I step closer to you.
This time I use my teeth.
I move along the cliff face.
I am right above your head.
You stay, I stay.
I have you inside my range.
The wind carries my scent to you.
I shift half a step along the ridge.
There is no path behind you.
I come down, step by step.
You can look up and still miss me.
My teeth stay bared.

lines.zh: 我一边跟一边数你的动作
lines.en: I follow and count your moves.
You should not have climbed this high.
I fold my wings back down.
This time I do not yield.
Do you hear the stones falling?
I lower my head and bite.
I used a fraction of my bite.
You are knocked down two ledges.
My talons rake past.
Rocks fall with it.
I shake my head.
I pull back my claws and watch you retreat.
My wings raise a gust.
My beak only grazes your skin.
You are still climbing.
I land behind you.
My tail cracks your leg.

lines.zh: 山风把你的喊声吹散了
lines.en: The wind scatters your shout.
I do not want to do that twice.
I drop out of the clouds.
This ridge has a master now.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀在气流里张开
lines.en: My wings open in the current.
I come down from higher still.
New claw marks on the rock.
The wind called first; then I came.
I land on the ledge without a sound.

lines.zh: 我在雪线以上待了很久
lines.en: I have been above the snowline a long while.
This altitude suits me.
I fold my wings.
The fog below has not lifted.

lines.zh: 雪从我的翅膀上滑下去
lines.en: Snow slides off my wings.
I have chosen this ledge.

lines.zh: 从我这里看得见整片谷
lines.en: From here I see the whole valley.
I settle down slowly.
It is quiet here; I like it.
Fire singes my feathers.
I slide down the cliff.
Water is not my element.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从岩台上震下来
lines.en: The blast shakes me off the ledge.
An arrow lodges in my wing.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的羽毛竖起来
lines.en: Magic makes my feathers rise.

lines.zh: 这片山上没什么可吃的
lines.en: There is little to eat on this mountain.
Lightning hits the summit and I flatten.
The mountain is gone from under me.
